Component relations are REQUIRED, not optional. Read the `imports` in the facts: whenever a module in one component imports a module in another component, emit a deduplicated component-level `relation` between those two components. Do NOT invent relations that no import supports; do NOT omit relations that imports do support. An architecture that has components but an empty `relations` list is INCOMPLETE."
